name: ai-game-studio
description: A safety-first, cross-platform AI game-production studio for Codex with integrated GDD authoring and build workflows, plus an offline catalog of 163 verified repositories.

interface.shortDescription: Write a build-ready GDD, then create and verify the game.
interface.longDescription: Combines the upstream AI Game Studio production workflows with GDD Interview and GDD Game Studio for source-grounded design, explicit gameplay and motion rules, asset coverage, implementation, and verification. The integration adds two Codex skills; the upstream studio workflows and curated catalog remain attributed to frabcd.
capabilities: 85 upstream game-development skills plus 2 GDD integration skills
Asset, visual, performance, and playability quality gates
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ai-game-studio:start to inspect this game project read-only, identify the best workflow, and propose the next safe step.
